about: From the producer of Lumines™ Electronic Symphony comes the underwater adventure of a lifetime, playable on both standard PS4 or in immersive VR on PS VR! Take control of two dolphins, Jupiter and Mars, who are on a mission to restore life to the oceans!
“A beautiful and surreal undersea adventure” - GameSpot

Set in a future Earth where sea levels have risen from melting ice caps, Jupiter and Mars must journey through submerged cities in order to neutralize a global network of machines that are disrupting sea life.
* Play from the perspective of Jupiter and direct your AI partner Mars
* Immerse yourself in stunning visuals and a mesmerizing soundtrack
* Find power-ups to access new areas and abilities
* Hunt for treasures and rescue sea creatures who need your help
summary: From the producer of Lumines™ Electronic Symphony comes the underwater adventure of a lifetime, playable on both standard PS4 or in immersive VR on PS VR!
